item.title: Green with possibility: Art Center Ukiah opens Spring show March 6
item.description: Mendocino County's spring reaches its fullest greenest phase in March, with new growth and flowers abundant everywhere. In this spirit, ‘A Thousand Shades of Green’ was chosen as the perfect theme for the March show at Art Center Ukiah.

item.title: How’s the market? Housing market need houses
item.description: Once again, I am baffled by lawmakers who think they can slice the same pie differently and end up with a bigger pie. That is not how it works. They can make different-sized pieces, but not more pie. I am referring to a couple of recent pronouncements about how our president and various lawmakers plan to “fix” the housing market.
